command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','SZ_Core'); `$results=foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { `$cmd='show running-config'; `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_08/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_07/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); `$a=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1; `$b=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2; `$la=`$a.output -split '\r?\n' | ForEach-Object { `$_.Trim() }; `$lb=`$b.output -split '\r?\n' | ForEach-Object { `$_.Trim() }; Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$la -DifferenceObject `$lb | Select-Object InputObject,SideIndicator }; `$results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5"
